x-m-el-job-02.title: Ukuthi Isantya Esifanayo Ngeeyunithi Ezimbini
x-m-el-job-02.goal: Usebenzisa uguqulo phakathi kwesantya ngomzuzu (m) nesantya ngeyure (km), fumana ngokwakho imeko apho onke amaxabiso amabini anamanani endalo, uze uchaze isizathu.
x-m-el-job-02.material: Abantu ababini kwiklabhu yokubaleka bachaza isantya esifanayo ngeeyunithi ezahlukileyo. Omnye wathi 'x m ngomzuzu' (umgama ohanjiswe kumzuzu e-1), kwaye omnye wathi 'y km ngeyure' (umgama ohanjiswe kwiyure e-1). Bafuna ukuthi amanani njengamanani endalo kuphela, ngaphandle kwamadesimali okanye amaqhezu.
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.0: 1 km = 1000 m, iyure e-1 = imizuzu engama-60
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.1: Isantya sichazwa njengomgama ohanjiswe kwixesha elilinganayo (inqanaba lesikolo esiphakamileyo)
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.prompt: Isantya somntu obaleka ngama-6 km ngeyure singamalunga nama-m amangaphi ngomzuzu? Kuqala qikelela ubungakanani.

x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wahlula loo mgama ngemizuzu engama-60 ukuqikelela umgama ohanjiswe kumzuzu e-1.

x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.c: 1000 m ngomzuzu ihambelana nama-60 km ngeyure. Hlola umlinganiselo wemizuzu e-1 neyure e-1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.explain: 6 km ngeyure yi-6000 m kwiyure e-1, kwaye iyure e-1 yimizuzu engama-60, ngoko yimalunga nama-100 m kumzuzu e-1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izibini ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo zamanani endalo, isantya ngomzuzu x (m) nesantya ngeyure y (km), ezenza isantya esifanayo. Isantya ngeyure sisuka kwi-6 ukuya kwi-20 kubandakanywa (uluhlu onokubaleka ngalo umntu).

x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.1: Misela isantya esinye ngeyure uhlole ukuba isantya ngomzuzu linani lendalo na.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.2: Ukuba ezinye iisantya ngeyure azinikeli manani endalo, khangela into eqhelekileyo kwezo santya.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c1: x no-y kufuneka zibe ngamanani endalo.

x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Isantya ngeyure kufuneka sibe sisuka kwi-6 ukuya kwi-20 kubandakanywa.
